summary: Destination XL Group, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its Agreement and Plan of Merger with FBB Holdings I, Inc. and Merger Sub. The amendment extends the merger end date from September 11, 2026 to October 30, 2026, but does not otherwise modify the agreement. DXL had previously filed a preliminary proxy statement for a stock issuance vote. The filing signals potential delays or regulatory hurdles in closing the merger, but no termination has occurred. Watch for whether the deal closes by the new deadline or faces further extension or termination.
